cues.en: The advantage of a higher pack voltage is that every conductor involved in making the car go

cues.en: And that’s why I’m genuinely worried on behalf of Tesla'a drivers.

*ahem*

cues.en: Soon, the competition that already exists in the 3rd party charging networks will drastically heat up.

cues.en: Really compelling EVs are being sold by just about every automaker at this point,

cues.zh: 而且发展速度还在迅速加快。
cues.en: and that’s accelerating quickly.

cues.zh: 我个人很高兴自己有一辆电动汽车。虽然现在开它长途旅行比开特斯拉更麻烦，
cues.en: I’m personally glad to have an EV that, while it’s currently more difficult to road-trip than a Tesla,

cues.zh: （它的充电速度还比任何一款特斯拉都快，不过我就不多炫耀了。）
cues.en: (it can also charge faster than any Tesla but l won’t rub it in too much).

cues.en: To everyone who thinks automakers should copy Tesla and build out their own charging networks,

cues.en: I’d ask that you consider what a future might look like where Ford is allowed to sell Ford Brand Electrons only to Fords.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，听起来Rivian可能会在他们的Adventure Network上走上这条路。
cues.en: Unfortunately it sounds like Rivian might be headed down that path with their Adventure Network.

cues.en: Ugh, this timeline…

cues.zh: 总之，把我的特斯拉焦虑放一边，
cues.en: Anyway, with my Tesla angst out of the way,

cues.zh: 剩下的就是这样；
cues.en: here’s what we’re left with;

cues.zh: 我们有技术能把350千瓦的功率直接输进汽车的电池包。
cues.en: We have the technology to deliver 350 kW of power straight into the battery pack of a car.

cues.zh: 我之前说过，这能让18小时的车程只需充电一小时。
cues.en: Earlier I said that would enable an 18 hour drive to happen with an hour of charging.

cues.zh: 那么，是这样实现的。
cues.en: Well, here’s how.

cues.zh: 我的Ioniq 5跑完那段旅程用了328千瓦时的电量。
cues.en: It took my Ioniq 5 328 kilowatt-hours of energy to make that journey.

cues.zh: 而……这比350少一点，
cues.en: And… that’s a bit less than 350,

cues.zh: 所以如果它有一块能承受全部功率的电池（它并没有，但我们现在是在理论上推演，不是现实）
cues.en: so if it had a battery which could take on all that power (which, it doesn’t but we’re playing with theory now not reality)

cues.zh: 总共需要的充电时间还不到一小时。
cues.en: not quite an hour of charging time would be needed in total.

cues.zh: 在未来的车里，这可能会分成四次15分钟的停靠，或者如果你更喜欢的话，六次10分钟的停靠。
cues.en: In a future car that might happen in four 15 minutes stops, or maybe six 10 minute stops if that's more your bag.

cues.zh: 而且，Ioniq 5 在高速巡航时的能效并非最高，
cues.en: Also, the Ioniq 5 isn’t the most efficient highway cruiser,

cues.zh: 所以换成 Tesla Model 3 这样的车，总充电时间可能会降到只有 45 分钟，
cues.en: so something like a Tesla Model 3 might be able to drop the total charging time down to only 45 minutes,

cues.zh: 只要电池技术跟得上。
cues.en: once battery tech catches up.

cues.zh: 那么，在现实世界的实际条件下，我这辆真车在现实中的实际充电时间是多少呢？
cues.en: Now, what was the real-world charge time with my real-world car in the real-world conditions of the real world?

cues.zh: 其实出奇地接近。
cues.en: Surprisingly close, actually.

cues.zh: 如果我们完全按照路线规划软件的建议来，
cues.en: Had we stuck to what our route planner suggested,

cues.zh: 也就是充到建议的电量百分比就拔枪，以确保到达下一个充电桩时还剩约 10% 的电量，
cues.en: which involved stopping the charge at a suggested percentage to reach the next charger with about 10% state-of-charge remaining,

cues.zh: 我们在 6 个不同的充电站总共只需要充 1 小时 52 分钟。
cues.en: we would have spent only 1 hour and 52 minutes charging at six different charging stops.

cues.zh: 只比理论上最佳的充电时间多了 52 分钟，已经很不错了。
cues.en: Just 52 minutes on top of the theoretical best-possible charging speed ain’t bad.

cues.zh: 不过，我们实际在充电桩多待了一会儿，超过了建议时间，
cues.en: Now, we did hang around the chargers for a little while longer than suggested

cues.zh: 因为我们出发时遇到了恼人的强逆风——我说的逆风是持续的
cues.en: because we were facing a nasty headwind when we started out - and by nasty I mean like a sustained

cues.zh: 每小时 15 到 20 英里的强逆风。
cues.en: 15 to 20 mile-an-hour headwind.

cues.zh: 所以实际上，我们总共花了2小时20分钟充电。
cues.en: So in actuality we spent a total of 2 hours and 20 minutes charging.

cues.zh: 那是我第一次开这辆车跑长途，
cues.en: It was my first time driving the car long distance,

cues.zh: 我想留点余量以防万一。
cues.en: and I wanted some buffer just in case.

cues.zh: 不过结果发现，路线规划器相当保守，因为即便在那种条件下，
cues.en: It turned out, though, that the route planner was being quite conservative as even in those conditions,

cues.zh: 每段行程之间预测的掉电量也非常准确。
cues.en: the predicted state-of-charge loss between stops was spot on.

cues.zh: 所以，如果我们按它的计划走，本来就没问题。
cues.en: So, had we stuck to its plan, we would have been fine.

cues.zh: 而随着我们向南行驶，顶风开始减弱，
cues.en: And as we moved South the headwind started to diminish,

cues.zh: 于是我们到达后续站点时，剩余电量越来越高于预测的到达续航。
cues.en: and so we started arriving at the next stops with more and more buffer over the predicted arrival range.

cues.zh: 这实际上本可以稍微缩短充电时间，
cues.en: Which, actually, would have shortened the charging time slightly

cues.zh: 因为后面那些充电时段开始时电量都高于预测，
cues.en: since those later charging sessions all started out at a higher-than-predicted state of charge,

cues.zh: 每站能省下几分钟。
cues.en: shaving off a few minutes at each stop.

cues.zh: 啊，最后那部分听起来确实让人觉得开电动车长途旅行需要做很多规划，对吧？
cues.en: Ah, that last section sure makes it sound like trying to road trip an EV takes a lot of planning, doesn’t it?

cues.zh: 嗯，差不多吧。
cues.en: Well, kind of.

cues.zh: 但其实也没那么夸张。
cues.en: But not too much, really.

cues.zh: 市面上有一些很棒的应用程序和网站能帮你搞定这些，
cues.en: There are some pretty great apps and websites out there which will help you manage this,

cues.zh: 比如 A Better Routeplanner，
cues.en: like A Better Routeplanner,

cues.zh: 还有一些车在效仿 Tesla 那种带充电站导航的系统，不过是基于现有的第三方充电网络。
cues.en: and several cars are emulating Tesla’s navigation-with-charging-stops system but around the available third-party networks.

cues.zh: 不过随着时间推移，肯定会有更多充电桩出现在更多地方，
cues.en: As time goes on, though, there will certainly be more chargers in more places,

cues.zh: 希望到那时整套路线规划这事儿就变得多余了。
cues.en: and hopefully this whole route planning business becomes obsolete.

cues.zh: 电动车还处于早期阶段，也并不适合所有人，
cues.en: It’s still early days for EVs and they’re not for everyone,

cues.zh: 但我希望你能看到，让它们跑起来的技术已经到位了，既可靠，又快。
cues.en: but I hope you can see that the tech to make them work is here, it’s robust, and it’s fast.

cues.zh: 我还想说，因为我之前已经跑过好几次同样的长途路线，
cues.en: And I want to say that, having done this same road trip several times before,

cues.zh: 每两三个小时强制休息 15 到 20 分钟，感觉特别棒，
cues.en: the forced 15 to 20 minute breaks every two or three hours were fantastic,

cues.zh: 而且这真的感觉是我去佛罗里达最快的一次旅行。
cues.en: and this genuinely felt like the fastest trip to Florida I’ve ever done.

cues.zh: 两个方向都行。
cues.en: In both directions.
